DLC2320:4:t_002:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number three! Another long-awaited arrival: our beautiful young captain!」

DLC2320:4:t_002:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful goddess of victory! Colonel $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_003:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Load all missile tubes! I will win this battle!」

DLC2320:4:t_003:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Are you sure about this, Captain? Taking part in something like this...」

DLC2320:4:t_003:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I have my pride as a woman too! I'll show $$カナメ$$ what kind of woman I am!」

DLC2320:4:t_003:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
（Whatever happens, don't blame me...）

DLC2320:4:t_003:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number four! A demon drill instructor puts her rookie through the wringer!」

DLC2320:4:t_003:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful mentor-and-pupil duo! Second Lieutenant $$メリッサ・マオ$$ and $$チコ・サイエンス$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_004:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「A beauty contest's fine, but why am I paired with Second Lieutenant $$マオ$$...?」

DLC2320:4:t_004:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$チコ$$! You've got talent, and there's only one reason you can't beat $$ラルク$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_004:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「You don't have enough hard work and guts! I'll take this opportunity to whip you into shape!」

DLC2320:4:t_004:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「I'll give you plenty of loving attention! The same loving attention Japanese sumo wrestlers give their juniors! Then you and I will take the crown!」

DLC2320:4:t_004:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「E-even $$カシオ$$ would be a better coach than this!」

DLC2320:4:t_004:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number five! Every young man's dream: the reliable older woman!」

DLC2320:4:t_004:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful senior ladies! Lieutenant $$エマ・シーン$$ and Lieutenant $$カナリア・ベルシュタイン$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_005:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
「...As I keep telling you, I am married. I do not qualify as a Miss...」

DLC2320:4:t_005:1.en:
$$エマ$$
「Perhaps it's about time for me, too...」

DLC2320:4:t_005:3.en:
$$エマ$$
「We haven't discussed anything definite, but now that the fighting has reached a lull...」

DLC2320:4:t_005:4.en:
$$カナリア$$
「I am glad you told me. Then for Captain $$ヘンケン$$'s sake, too, we'll have to give you one last moment in the spotlight.」

DLC2320:4:t_005:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number six! Slacking students will be put through their paces!」

DLC2320:4:t_005:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful instructors! $$ルクレツィア・ノイン$$ and $$ヨーコ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_006:0.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Any naughty students get private lessons!」

DLC2320:4:t_006:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I promise you guidance and care to rival Ms. $$スズネ$$'s.」

DLC2320:4:t_006:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number seven! The $$バラの女王$$ teams up with the Empress of the Seas!」

DLC2320:4:t_006:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful empresses! $$オオタ・カズミ$$ and $$ラケージ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_007:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「This atmosphere isn't bad at all, is it?」

DLC2320:4:t_007:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Indeed... That crown belongs to us.」

DLC2320:4:t_007:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number eight! Another dazzling team! The iron lady joins forces with a beautiful girl built for battle!」

DLC2320:4:t_007:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful pink-haired goddesses of war! $$ハマーン・カーン$$ and $$ノノ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_008:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This event is ridiculous, but I have no taste for losing to anyone.」

DLC2320:4:t_008:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「We will give it our all, $$ノノ$$.」

DLC2320:4:t_008:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「May $$ノノ$$ call you Lady $$ハマーン$$ too!?」

DLC2320:4:t_008:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I am deeply honored! $$ノノ$$ dedicates her life to you, Lady $$ハマーン$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_008:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
（I-I'm being overwhelmed by her pressure...!?）

DLC2320:4:t_008:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number nine! A change of pace: two fresh young faces! Rivals in love team up for some $$ファ$$-fi-fu-fe-$$フォウ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_008:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful $$エゥーゴ$$ ladies! $$ファ・ユイリィ$$ and $$フォウ・ムラサメ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_009:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「It's just $$ＡＧ$$ mouthing off as usual. Don't let it bother you.」

DLC2320:4:t_009:2.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Hehe... Let's do our best so $$カミーユ$$ will praise us, $$ファ$$.」

DLC2320:4:t_009:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number ten! Count on their support, in battle and in your private life!」

DLC2320:4:t_009:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful partners! $$弓さやか$$ and $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_010:1.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アマタ$$, I'll do my best!」

DLC2320:4:t_010:2.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Go for it, $$ミコノ$$! Show them the guts that won you the Elements' qualifying contest!」

DLC2320:4:t_010:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「You had a contest like that...!?」

DLC2320:4:t_010:4.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「It was such a dirty fight, I can't even talk about it here. And $$ミコノ$$ came out on top.」

DLC2320:4:t_010:5.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「C-can we please stop talking about that...?」

DLC2320:4:t_010:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
（I can't get enough of that bashfulness...!）

DLC2320:4:t_010:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number eleven! Red machines are a mark of courage! The $$ボランティア部$$'s senior-and-junior team takes the stage!」

DLC2320:4:t_010:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful spirit of service! $$紅月カレン$$ and $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_011:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「If we're doing this, we're winning, $$アスカ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_011:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's not like you, $$アスカ$$. Whatever you might say, you're usually the one who gets most fired up at times like this.」

DLC2320:4:t_011:5.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Let's do this, $$カレン$$! We're definitely going to win!」

DLC2320:4:t_011:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number twelve! Men, hold your tongues! Women, hold yours too!」

DLC2320:4:t_011:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful silence! $$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ and $$アヤナミレイ$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_012:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
（Even I find this silence hard to bear...）

DLC2320:4:t_012:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number thirteen! Pink machines packed with mysteries!」

DLC2320:4:t_012:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful enigmas! $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ and $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$!」

DLC2320:4:t_013:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But not a bad one. A good woman always has her secrets.」

DLC2320:4:t_013:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「By the way... How old are you?」

DLC2320:4:t_013:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「One should never ask a woman's age. That goes for both of us.」

DLC2320:4:t_013:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Entry number fourteen! The truth about me is...!」

DLC2320:4:t_013:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our beautiful wild side! $$飛鷹葵$$, $$館華くらら$$, and $$エイーダ・ロッサ$$, with $$ヒルデ・シュバイカー$$!」

review.context: AG introduces beauty-contest entrants three through fourteen, with each team revealing friendly rivalry, romance and character-specific jokes.
decisions: Retained the Fa/Four tongue-twister as Fa-fi-fu-fe-Four.
Mao uses sumo loving attention as a euphemism for brutal training.
Rei Tentative Name is the clone character, separate from the other Rei tokens.
Asuka stays the Evangelion character, not Shinn Asuka.
